tool_input.command: cd <repo> && bd create "Evict pre-seal legacy runtime audit logs from git tracking" --type task --priority 2 --description "The two-zone audit design (DES-058) is implemented and running: live audit/mission logs write to .punt-labs/local/ethos/ (gitignored), sealed+scrubbed chunks land in the tracked .punt-labs/ethos/ tree (internal/audit/seal.go, internal/hook/audit_seal.go, audit_content.go). New sessions correctly write live state to .punt-labs/local/ (confirmed on disk). But files written into the tracked tree BEFORE that migration remain in the git index and cannot be evicted by an ignore rule alone. Tracked residue in the ethos repo under .punt-labs/ethos/: hundreds of per-session runtime logs (missions/**/log-<uuid>-<ts>-<ts>.jsonl, log-no-session-*, log-regen-*, log-verify-*); bare missions/**/log.jsonl (VERIFY: durable mission event log per traceability-data-assets.md section 2 is meant to be tracked; do NOT evict that — only runtime churn); sessions/**/audit.jsonl per-session audit logs (live-zone class, never should have been tracked). Also ethos root .gitignore lacks a .punt-labs/ethos/sessions/ rule that lux/vox/z-spec/punt-kit carry, and nothing covers a bare log.jsonl." --acceptance "Pre-seal runtime logs (log-<uuid>*.jsonl, sessions/**/audit*.jsonl, and bare log.jsonl IF confirmed runtime not durable) are git rm --cached from the ethos index. .gitignore gains the missing sessions/ rule and a bare log.jsonl rule. Durable mission records stay tracked. git status clean after. Destructive git op: run git-safety checks (biff who/finger, git status) and coordinate before executing."
